title: Enterprise Interface and Cryptographic Profile
description: Describes logical service interfaces, key management utilities, administrative security policies, and cryptographic protection mechanisms. Generated independently of any SBOM and merged downstream.

standard.description: FIPS 140 standard version under which the module was validated

cavp_certificate.description: CAVP or ACVP algorithm certificate reference (e.g., #A2470, C1187)

cmvp_certificate_url.description: URL to the NIST CMVP module certificate entry

augmented.description: Whether the EAL is augmented (e.g., EAL4+)

protection_profile.description: Protection Profile the evaluation is against (e.g., NDPP, App PP)

niap_certificate_url.description: URL to the NIAP or CCRA certificate entry

algorithm.description: A single cryptographic algorithm provided by a library

name.description: Algorithm name (e.g., AES-256-GCM, RSA-4096, ECDH-P384, ML-KEM-768, SHA-384)

min_key_size.description: Minimum key or security parameter size in bits

standard_ref.description: Governing standard (e.g., FIPS 197, SP 800-38A, FIPS 186-4, SP 800-90A)

modes.description: Validated modes of operation (e.g., CBC, GCM, KW, PSS, CMAC)

compliance.description: Editorial compliance and quantum-safety assessments — interpretations, not physical facts

fips_approved.description: Whether this algorithm is approved for use in FIPS mode

fips_approved_context.description: Scope of the FIPS approval (e.g., SP 800-131A Rev2, FIPS 197, key size ≥ 2048)

quantum_safe.description: Whether this algorithm is considered quantum-safe under current guidance

quantum_safe_basis.description: The standard or authority on which the quantum-safety assessment is based

sbom_ref.description: Optional reference to a companion SBOM merged downstream (urn, serialNumber, or bom-ref)

cryptographic_libraries.description: Cryptographic library implementations and the algorithms they provide. Libraries are the correct owner of algorithm lists; interfaces reference a library by library_id.

name.description: Library name (e.g., ICC, OpenJCEPlusFIPS, OpenSSL, SCHANNEL, GSKit)

os.description: Operating system and environment this entry applies to (e.g., Linux x86_64, z/OS 3.1)

security_provider.description: Security engine that wraps this library (e.g., GSKit v9, JSSE, SslStream, System SSL)

algorithms.description: Algorithms supported by this library on this platform

interfaces.description: The active messaging, transport, client-binding, and administrative network listeners.

data_sensitivity.description: Sensitivity classification of the data payloads carried by this interface

network_plane.description: Network tier on which this interface operates

name.description: Application layer protocol name (e.g., MQI, JMS, REST, AMQP, MQTT)

port.description: Bind port number or 0 if client-originated dynamic socket

supported_versions.description: Supported protocol versions (e.g., TLS 1.2, TLS 1.3, SSH-2)

cipher_suites.description: AEAD cipher suites (e.g., TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384, TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256). For TLS 1.2 these encode key exchange + cipher + MAC; for TLS 1.3 they encode cipher + hash only.

key_exchange_groups.description: TLS supported_groups / named curves negotiated for key exchange (e.g., x25519, P-256, P-384, ML-KEM-768, X25519Kyber768Draft00). Required to fully describe TLS 1.3 key exchange.

signature_algorithms.description: TLS signature_algorithms extension values for authentication (e.g., ecdsa_secp256r1_sha256, rsa_pss_rsae_sha256, ed25519)

features.description: Security enhancements and hardening features supported by this interface

platforms.description: Per-OS deployment variants referencing a cryptographic_libraries entry

os.description: Operating system and environment (e.g., Linux x86_64, Windows Server 2022, IBM i 7.5, z/OS 3.1)

security_provider.description: The security engine provider (e.g., GSKit v9, JSSE, SslStream, System SSL)

cryptographic_library.description: Binary engine providing cryptographic services (e.g., ICC, OpenJCEPlusFIPS, SCHANNEL, OpenSSL)

cryptographic_library_ref.description: References a cryptographic_libraries[].library_id entry for algorithm and compliance details

key_management_interfaces.description: Administrative utilities used to create, rotate, and manage key/certificate stores.

name.description: Utility or binary name (e.g., runmqakm, runmqktool, mqiptKeytool, keytool, certutil)

interface_type.description: Interaction mode of the key management tool

store_type.description: Type of cryptographic store managed by this utility

key_operations.description: Key lifecycle operations supported by this interface

key_entry_method.description: Method used for key entry into the module or store

fips_compliant_management.description: Whether the tool supports FIPS-certified key operations

platforms.description: Platforms on which this key management tool is available

security_controls.description: Policy-based access, credential authentication, message-level protection, and revocation systems.

name.description: Name of the security control/policy (e.g., CONNAUTH, CHLAUTH, AMS)

control_type.description: Functional category of the security control

governing_parameters.description: Configuration attributes governing this control (e.g., ADOPTCTX, SSLPEERMAP, CERTLABL)

external_dependencies.description: External resources required at runtime (e.g., LDAP directory, OIDC Provider, OCSP Responder, HSM, Vault)

status.description: Operational status of this control on the given platform
Whether transport protection is enabled, merely supported, or disabled

protocol_used.description: Transport security protocol in use (e.g., TLS 1.3, IPsec, SSH-2)

hardening_parameters.description: Additional hardening configuration applied (e.g., DISABLE_TLS_1.0, REQUIRE_CLIENT_CERT)

name.description: Role name (e.g., Crypto Officer, User, Administrator)

authentication_algorithm.description: Algorithm used for authentication (e.g., ECDSA P-521 SHA-512, RSA-2048 SHA-256)

roles.description: Roles and their authentication requirements governing this control

status.description: Whether secret protection is enabled, merely supported, or disabled

protection_method.description: Mechanism used to protect secret material (passwords, keys) at rest

status.description: Whether data-at-rest encryption is enabled, merely supported, or disabled

encryption_algorithm.description: Algorithm used for data-at-rest encryption (e.g., AES-256-GCM, AES-256-XTS)

key_management_ref.description: Reference to the key_management_interfaces entry responsible for this key

hardware_acceleration.description: Whether hardware acceleration (e.g., AES-NI, CPACF) is used

created.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this profile was generated

last_updated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent modification

author.description: Individual or team responsible for this profile

information_source.description: The primary artefact from which cryptographic information was extracted

lifecycle_stage.description: Product lifecycle stage this profile represents

schema_version.description: Version of the cprofile schema used (e.g., 1.0.0)

cbomgen_version.description: Version of the CBOMgen tool that generated this profile
